name: Entity Reference Deck Preview
description: Live front-end preview for Entity Reference Deck cards (iframe + Lit shell). Does not ship iframe-resizer; install it on the site.
project_description: Optional soft-dep submodule of Entity Reference Deck. Renders a live front-end preview of a referenced entity inside its deck card via a sandboxed iframe and a Lit web-component shell. It owns the PreviewProvider plugin manager (PreviewProviderManager) whose plugins build per-entity-type preview content; hosts ship the default providers. It exposes two preview routes — a persisted-entity route (permission + entity.view + custom access + provider access) and a draft-token route (high-entropy bearer token bound to uid + entity, redeemed with hash_equals from an expirable key-value store) — plus preview_refresh / preview_toggle card actions, a preview toolbar group, and a settings form at /admin/config/content/entity-reference-deck-preview (draft_ttl, responsive toolbar/device presets). Preview always renders as the current authenticated user (no AccountSwitcher) and sets Referrer-Policy: no-referrer with uncacheable draft responses. It does NOT ship iframe-resizer (v5); install it on the site under /libraries. Permission: 'use entity reference deck preview'.
